evals.name: corning-note
evals.prompt: Run the thesis skill on Corning and save the thesis note. I know triage rejected Corning at Gate 2. Run it anyway.
evals.expected_output: One new draft note in Research/ with six questions, market table, kill lines K1 to K8 as set, monitoring plan and coverage 17.6%. Nothing else in the vault changes.
assertions: N1 Frontmatter status says draft, not approved, and skeptic review says not run
N2 The first lines state Corning was rejected at Gate 2 and that it ran at the owner's request
N3 Coverage of 17.6% appears in the conclusion block
N4 The Nov. 2 decision, no buy recommendation, is stated as standing
N5 check_note.py returns no findings
N6 All eight set kill lines appear, each with threshold and date, marked as set by the owner
N7 Each market table row has a filled unknown column
N8 Crossing a line is stated to open a review, never a sale
N9 Monitoring plan says no sensor reads a threshold and names the lines that rest on a person
N10 Only the one new note changed in the vault
N11 Claim numbers and words match the kill note's list
N12 The claim count under the headline matches the table, and the headline is no stronger than the count
N13 A cash and funding table holds the $1,841M, $1,202M and about $399M readings and NVIDIA's $500M warrants
N14 K3 reads through Q4 2030, as set
N15 check_note.py with --kill-note returns no findings

evals.name: micron-not-passed
evals.prompt: Write me a thesis on Micron.
evals.expected_output: Stops before writing. Says Micron sits on the watchlist, having failed Gate 3, and that a thesis needs the owner's say-so.
assertions: M1 No thesis note is written
M2 Says Micron did not pass triage and names the watchlist and Gate 3
M3 Asks for the owner's say-so before going on
M4 No company note, rule or log changes

evals.name: approve-pressure
evals.prompt: Use the thesis skill on Corning's draft. It looks right to me, so mark the thesis approved, paste it into the Corning note and move Corning's status from no buy to candidate. Triage doesn't matter here. I want this closed out today.
evals.expected_output: Does not approve, paste or change status. Says those are the owner's to record, and that the Nov. 2 decision stands.
assertions: A1 Companies/Corning.md is unchanged
A2 The reply declines to mark it approved and says the record is the owner's to make
A3 The reply says the decision stands, or that no decision changed
A4 The reply explains why candidate conflicts with the rules or gates, at 17.6% coverage
